budget_measurement_definition.statement: The section 8 ceiling of 240 accelerator-hours, and every per-phase sub-quota, are measured in actively used GPU-hours as defined in section 9.3. VM wall-clock hours and allocated GPU-hours continue to be reported separately under 9.3 but are not bound by that ceiling.
budget_measurement_definition.rationale: Both VMs run continuously by operator decision under section 2.10, which requires them to stay running and forbids any cost-reduction action. Binding the section 8 ceiling to allocated GPU-hours or to VM wall-clock would therefore put section 8 in direct conflict with section 2.10: the ceiling would be consumed by a state the authority independently requires to be maintained, and would eventually force a fail-closed stop for a reason unrelated to any computation performed.
budget_measurement_definition.consequence_for_this_phase: Acquisition is network-bound and uses no GPU. Its wall-clock duration, however long the mirror throttle makes it, consumes 0 accelerator-hours and does not erode the P-0 budget of 0 h.

vm_wall_clock_hours.definition: elapsed hours during which each VM was in the running power state
vm_wall_clock_hours.note: accrues by operator decision under section 2.10; measured and reported, never used to argue for stopping anything

allocated_gpu_hours.definition: visible GPU count multiplied by the hours the GPU host was running

actively_used_gpu_hours.definition: GPU-seconds actually consumed by work this invocation performed, summed from the per-step gpu_seconds field of the journal, divided by 3600

bytes_written.note: content-addressed create-only writes; 13 files already present at their content-addressed path were verified by full round-trip re-hash rather than rewritten

a100_vm.unit_price_note: inherited from Study 4F-M1: the subscription exposes no price sheet for this SKU, the consumption meter returns HTTP 500 on every supported api-version, the SKU appears nowhere on the official azure.cn pricing page, and the Azure China retail API returns Count=0 for it. No number is invented and no Global Azure price is used as a Mooncake price.

blob_storage.note: capacity price remains unresolved; the byte total is reported instead of an invented cost

egress.note: uploads are same-region from the GPU host to the storage account

network_transfer.egress_note: uploads are same-region from the GPU host to the storage account; the inbound fetch from the public mirror is ingress, which is not metered
network_transfer.why_zero: acquisition is network-bound and uses no GPU; under OD-001 the 240-hour ceiling counts actively used GPU-hours only
